name: open-object-patch-op-extras
description: where the schema deliberately leaves an object open, an undescribed member is not unrecognised material: a JSON Patch remove carrying a leftover value arrives whole, applies, and draws no warning
kill: drop the `specOpen` check in stripAgainst so the RFC 6902 operations are stripped like the protocol's own objects — the stale `value` on the remove is then deleted and a warning names `/delta/0/value`, which is a warning about conformant data and fails `noWarnings`. `eventTypes` covers the harsher way to get this wrong: treating the operation's extra member as unrecognised material at the event level and discarding STATE_DELTA whole, which the delivered list catches even though the reduced state would still be asserted.
